entities.summary: Evgeny Muratov is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who currently plays for Yugra Khanty-Mansiysk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He had previously played in the KHL with HC Sibir Novosibirsk. He was selected by the Edmonton Oilers in the 9th round of the 2000 NHL Entry Draft.
